newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix President, CEO Jerry Rogers resigns.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix President, CEO Jerry Rogers resigns.

text.p: Cyrix Corp., a leading supplier of high-performance computer chips, said Monday that Jerry Rogers has resigned as president and chief executive.
The Richardson, Texas-based company did not specify why Rogers, who will remain on the company's board, resigned.
Cyrix officials were not immediately available for comment.
Jay Swent, Cyrix's senior vice president of finance and administration, will temporarily replace Rogers in a newly established office of the president until a permanent replacement is found.
Kevin McDonough, senior vice president of engineering; Nancy Dechaud, vice president of manufacturing; and members of the board of directors will also serve in the office.
The company will retain an executive search firm to replace Rogers, it added.
Cyrix's stock rose $1 to $22.375 on Nasdaq.
